message.content: This editorial illustration, a magazine cover for "TEMPO" dated "27 JULI-2 AGUSTUS 2020," features an outdoor scene beneath large green banana leaves and bunches of green bananas. The central focus is a group of seven people gathered together. Three women wear headscarves (hijabs); one in purple holds a red book, another in tan stands centrally, and a third in white is seated on the left. Four males are present: an older man in a white tunic and dark cap stands holding a light-colored mug; a man in a white tunic, glasses, and white cap sits on the right; a younger man in a white shirt and dark cap sits with his back to the viewer; and a small boy in a grey shirt and dark cap sits on the far right holding a red book. A taller boy with a shaved head and markings on his arm stands behind them. Several chickens—roosters with red combs—are scattered in the foreground and background. A white cat lies curled on the ground. A small blue sign reads "PASANG CCTV." The text "JALAN PEDANG DAI KAMPUNG" is prominently displayed in white letters.
